description: Java source file implementing a custom ContentInfo listener (MyReceiver) for handling content URIs, particularly images, in an Android application. It processes incoming content, stores images locally, and displays messages for other content types.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: A class implementing OnReceiveContentListener to handle incoming content, process images, and show messages for other content types.

methods.name: onReceiveContent
methods.description: Handles incoming ContentInfo, splits into URI and non-URI content, and delegates URI content processing.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Processes content URIs, stores images locally, and updates UI with attachments.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a toast with content type and size for non-image content.
